name: Three Bells at Dusk
short_role: Combine all three P11 questions in one advanced Greywatch defense.
question: Can the keep preserve distinct answers as armored, obscured, and protection-piercing pressure overlap?
objective: Complete three mixed waves without collapsing the keep's response network.
lesson: A resilient plan layers direct counters, reliable warning, and a secondary line instead of overinvesting in one answer.
